prepared.text: The doctor prepared transfer papers and arrangements; the narrator says she told his wife that she would leave.
prepared.limit: Preparation and notice to the wife do not themselves establish completed care or notice to the narrator.

apology.text: The account preserves an immediate apology and the narrator’s recollection of its quality.
apology.limit: Neither the apology nor the reported absence cancels the other.

access.text: The narrator reports that he no longer had access to a primary-care physician and remained without care.
access.limit: The report is retained as supplied; it does not establish every unseen institutional step.

routing.text: He asks that his report be received as his report and passed to someone who can respond.
routing.limit: This is distinct from requiring the recipient to agree with a classification or decide the law.

authority.text: The narrator says he does not know the staff member’s training or authority.
authority.limit: Unknown remains unknown; no inference of zero authority, intent, or absence of the encounter.

source_card.title: A printed measurement has an acknowledged correction in correspondence
source_card.representation: Assistant paraphrase; not a verbatim transcript or certificate

sources.statement: The report prints approximately 6 cm of one vertebral displacement twice. It also describes a separate 3 mm displacement and says the findings are unchanged with flexion and extension.
The later patient letter quotes the 6 cm value and says a follow-up inquiry established it was wrong.
The portal thread attributes a reply to a nurse practitioner acknowledging a typographical error in the radiology report and stating that it should be 6 mm.

observed_omissions: The inspected sources do not supply an amended original radiology report or source imaging pixels. The correcting correspondence is available and must be included in the comparison.
limits_and_uncertainties: Preserve the original report’s printed 6 cm and the correspondence’s 6 mm correction as separate source statements.
The attributed nurse-practitioner reply documents a correspondence correction; it is not an original radiology amendment or an independent image measurement.
A portal PDF does not by itself authenticate message authorship, source-system completeness or delivery history.
questions_for_review: Was the original radiology report formally amended, and can the original or amended report and images be matched to this correspondence?

relationships.locator: report p1; later letter p8; correspondence p1, 12:29 PM reply
relationships.contribution: Preserves the printed value, the author’s later account and the already-available attributed correction to 6 mm.
relationships.does_not_establish: A formal amendment of the original radiology report, independent image measurement, message authenticity or clinical implications.

chronology.value: 2019-06-12 12:29 PM; this reply does not itself state a timezone

source_card.title: Different representations do not create independent corroboration
source_card.representation: Assistant paraphrase; not a verbatim transcript or certificate

sources.statement: The received scan contains an incremental annotation update.
The other received PDF is the earlier byte prefix. Its rendered pages match the corresponding visible pages, but it lacks that later annotation object.
A laboratory result appears in one export.
A second export contains the same result identifiers and values with different print representation. The identifiers themselves are withheld.

observed_omissions: These representations do not identify who made an update, why it was made, or provide independent repeat testing.
limits_and_uncertainties: Different byte objects, filenames or delivery receipts do not by themselves establish independent sources.
A source-family relationship is more precise than calling every variant an exact duplicate.
No editing motive or misconduct is inferred from the incremental update.
questions_for_review: Which comparison concerns raw byte identity, matching rendered content, repeated report content, or a genuinely independent observation?

relationships.locator: other scan complete object and matching pages
relationships.contribution: Preserves the distinction between the earlier PDF and its incremental update.
relationships.does_not_establish: Who edited it, why, authenticity or independent corroboration.

relationships.locator: scan versions and repeated laboratory-result exports
relationships.contribution: Prevents repeated representations from being counted as independent observations.
relationships.does_not_establish: Source truth or the completeness of the upstream record.
